title: Single-degree exact-term Hom preserves quasi-isomorphisms
statement: Let C be a small category, J a Grothendieck topology and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Let P be a cochain complex of sheaves of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and fix an integer k. Assume P^n is zero for n different from k, and internal sheaf Hom from P^k preserves short exact sequences. For every quasi-isomorphism f:M to N of arbitrary cochain complexes [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], the induced map Hom(P,M) to Hom(P,N) [def-pur-hom-complex] is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0A8X, Hom products and differential; Tag 08DM, bounded Hom calculation; Tag 010N, exact functors; step 1 of lem-pc-bounded-exact-term-hom-quasi-iso

proof.text: Every product factor except the one at k is zero. Use the product universal property to identify Hom(P,M)^n with internal Hom(P^k,M^(k+n)). Since every source differential vanishes, the differential is postcomposition with d_M. The identification commutes with f componentwise, including when P^k is zero.
The internal Hom functor is additive sectionwise. Short-exact-sequence preservation gives finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation by the exact-functor criterion.

Apply the natural homology comparison for an exact functor to the degreewise image of M and N. The map on cohomology is an isomorphism because f is a quasi-isomorphism. Translation of the grading by k does not affect this assertion.

proof_origin.place: The bounded exact-term Hom argument, separated into its single-degree and split-tail calculations

theorem quasiIso_homComplex_map_of_single_degree_exact_term
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ)
    (k : ℤ) (hsingle : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ k → IsZero (P.X n))
    (hexact : ∀ (S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))),
      S.ShortExact → ∃ hz : SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 (P.X k)) S.f ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 (P.X k)) S.g = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 (P.X k)) S.f)
          (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 (P.X k)) S.g) hz).ShortExact)
    {M N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ}
    (f : M ⟶ N) [QuasiIso f] :
    QuasiIso (((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).obj (op P)).map f)
